items.title: General Mills Just Gained 15% in a Month: Take Profits, or Buy More?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGeneral Mills is up 15% in the past month, lifted by Procter & Gamble’s and Kraft Heinz’s quarterly reports while tech stocks sold off. General Mills had no news of its own behind the move, and Campbell’s ran even further.

items.title: Are Your Dividends Safe? 4 Companies Whose Debt Is Competing With the Payout
items.summary: Bondholders get paid first, and shareholders get whatever the board leaves behind. Four high-yield stocks, from a hospital landlord to a telecom giant, are now squeezed between rising interest costs and the checks sent to investors. Which payout bends first?

items.title: KHC Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Turnaround and Inflation Pressures
items.summary: Kraft Heinz raises its 2026 earnings outlook after a Q3 beat, but rising inflation, sluggish U.S. retail recovery and 2027 pricing plans pose challenges.

items.title: Campbell’s Just Gained 13% in a Week: Take Profits, or Buy More?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCampbell’s stock rose 13% in the week through Nov. 4, with the biggest jump coming after Kraft Heinz’s third-quarter report lifted packaged-food stocks that day.

items.title: Kraft Heinz: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Rising logistics and fuel costs leave shelf-level pricing as the open question, with productivity gains the first line of defense.

items.title: Kraft Heinz (KHC) Agreed To Exit Its North American Coffee Business
items.summary: Kraft Heinz (NYSE:KHC) agreed to sell its North American coffee business to One Rock Capital Partners, according to an announcement tied to Q3 results. The transaction is positioned to help Kraft Heinz concentrate on core brands and reduce debt tied to its packaged food portfolio. Alongside a Q3 profit beat, Kraft Heinz raised its 2026 earnings forecast, signaling management’s confidence in the multi year plan. The sale of the North American coffee unit and the higher 2026 earnings outlook...

items.title: The Kraft Heinz Co (KHC) (Q3 2026) Earnings Call Highlights: Coffee Divestiture, Narrowed ...
items.summary: The Kraft Heinz Co (KHC) beat top-line expectations and struck a deal to divest its North American coffee business, but inflation above 5% and lagging market share gains loom over 2027.

items.title: General Mills Soars 5% With Packaged Food as Kraft Heinz Calls 2027 Price Hikes “Likely”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGeneral Mills shares rose 5% today with Campbell’s, Conagra and Smucker after Kraft Heinz said price increases are likely in 2027. Investors are betting packaged-food makers can pass rising costs on to shoppers.
